title: Presentation proof and session context verification
description: Presentation proof and session context verification.
acceptance: Verifier issues a single-use verifier_nonce of at least DV-ATA-05 bits that expires after DV-ATA-04
Proof is an Ed25519 signature over typ amk-ata-presentation-v1, aud, attestation_nonce, verifier_nonce and timestamp
Re-presenting the same attestation with a fresh proof is accepted; a reused verifier_nonce is rejected
Mismatched session handle or epoch is rejected
findings: Correction: imported plan tracked attestation nonces at every verifier. That blocks legitimate re-presentation and does not stop a stolen attestation. Replay defence is the presentation proof; request nonces are tracked at issuance.
